findings.title: POS V4 SPA /kiosk/idle redirect race breaks direct POS catalog->cart->Encaisser flow
findings.details: Repeating pattern observed: navigate to /admin/pos-v4 → SPA renders → opening any modal (wizard or CC) or any background tab activity to /kiosk/idle causes pos-app.js Vue router guard to invalidate auth state and bounce to /kiosk/idle even with valid Laravel admin session cookie present. The /admin/pos-v4 Blade has NO server-side auth middleware (per AdminPosV4Controller.php comment 'Auth is enforced client-side by pos-app.js'). The client-side guard appears overly aggressive — it should re-verify session via /api/me before redirecting on internal navigations. IMPACT: cashier cannot reliably complete a sale if any kiosk activity exists in parallel (very likely in prod where multiple kiosk borne sessions run constantly). Multi-instance racing also possible if 2+ POS terminals on same machine. WORKAROUND: hard-reload /admin/pos-v4 to recover. ROOT CAUSE candidates: (a) shared localStorage 'kiosk_*' key contention with admin token, (b) BroadcastChannel cross-tab listener treating kiosk-idle navigation as logout signal, (c) Sanctum token expiry detection race. Reproduce: open POS, open another tab to /kiosk/idle, return to POS — POS bounces to /kiosk/idle. NEED: backend session/api check before client-side redirect.
findings.recommended_action: Add backend /api/me ping in pos-app.js router guard before any /kiosk/* redirect; OR scope localStorage tokens by surface (admin_token vs kiosk_token); OR ignore kiosk-idle BroadcastChannel signals when current path matches /admin/*.
